大日本帝國統計年鑑 1935

Dai Nippon Teikoku tōkei nenkan (Statistical Yearbook of the Empire of Japan), 第五十四回 (No. 54), 昭和十年 (Shōwa 10)
內閣統計局, 東京 (昭和十年)

All 442 numbered tables are transcribed, with the summary tables, two unnumbered sub-tables printed beside numbered ones, and the front-matter tables of weights and measures and of currency parities and exchange rates (from the volume's front-matter scan); the contents, the index, the page of charts, the explanatory notes (略說) and the bureau's list of publications are not. The page images are two-page spreads about 2,000 px wide, so the small type was read from enlarged crops. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one, and long tables read in sections by different readers are joined; table 402 (conscription examinations), printed in three sections, is given as parts. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted (many differ by one or two units of rounding in thousand-yen figures). Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Misprints are kept as printed and noted; table 201 is printed with the number 200 and is filed as 201. The volume's errata slip (正誤表, 33 corrections) is attached as a note to each table it concerns; the figures stay as printed. About 210 of some 224,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?]; a literal ? printed in the book is kept as ?. Scan links open the page image in the Hitotsubashi database; please credit that database when using these transcriptions.
